verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Bitbucket switched its markup from Creole to Markdown, offers a preview in issue comments, and renders the README prominently on the overview page, with formatted headings and pre blocks. The evidence is old, community-only, and notes cramped README rendering. missing for 10: first-party documentation of Markdown support across READMEs, issues and comments, evidence of syntax-highlighted code blocks, live preview, current hands-on corroboration.
